source.name: NGSL 1.2 + NAWL 1.2 + TSL 1.2 + NGSL supplementary headwords
source.description: 4836 unique lowercase headwords/entries from openly licensed general, academic and TOEIC-oriented English lists; an exclusion reference for candidate-word collection, not an official IELTS syllabus or a claim that the learner knows these words. No meanings or translations. Original spelling and the single entry "ice cream" are retained. Exact word matching alone does not resolve inflections or British/American variants.
modifications: Removed source descriptions, numbering, and inflected supplement columns.
Lowercased, deduplicated, alphabetically sorted, and combined four headword lists.
No entries were invented or added to reach a target count.
